source: # Write PSP specific reports to csv
#Attivazione modalità "dynamic" per la scrittura delle partizioni
spark.conf.set("spark.sql.sources.partitionOverwriteMode", "dynamic")

from pyspark.sql.types import StructType, StructField, IntegerType
from datetime import date, timedelta, datetime
from pyspark.sql.functions import *
from py4j.protocol import Py4JJavaError
import pandas as pd

## Reference time indicators

In this section, the invoce period is set.\
The reference date is 5 days before the current date.\
The current date is by default the day on which the job runs.\
However, this can be overwritten by uncommenting the next cell of code and inserting the year, month, and day of choice.

current_year_month = '202412'
reference_year_quarter = '2024_4'
container_path = ''

reference_year = reference_year_quarter[:4]
reference_quarter = reference_year_quarter[5:]

print(f"Current year_month: {current_year_month}\nReference year_quarter: {reference_year_quarter}")
%run /process_quarter_trx_common
_, df_trx_contracts = join_trx_contracts(current_year_month, reference_year, reference_quarter)
# Detailed Report

# Write temporary data

partition_key = "recipient_id"
tmp_path = f"{container_path}/tmp/DetailedReport"

df_trx_contracts.withColumnRenamed("psp_id", "cf_psp").withColumnRenamed("psp_name", "psp")\
    .select("year", "quarter", "giorno", "abi", "category", "contract_type", "recipient_id", "provider_id", "iuv", "sorgente", "cf_psp", "psp")\
    .sort(asc("recipient_id"), asc("iuv"))\
    .coalesce(1) \
    .write\
    .mode("overwrite")\
    .partitionBy(partition_key)\
    .option("header","true")\
    .csv(tmp_path)

##### Move each PSP report from the temporary folder to its designated folder

- Extraction of the psp_id from the partition path
- Creation of a psp_id:path dictionary
- Move the files from the path stored in the dictionary to the PSP folder
# QuarterAgentReport

df_trx_quarter_recipient = spark.sql(f'''
SELECT 
    year,
    quarter,
    month,
    provider_id,
    abi,
    category,
    contract_type,
    recipient_id,
    sum(n_transactions) as trx
FROM pagopa.trx_quarter where year_quarter = '{reference_year_quarter}'
GROUP BY year, quarter, month, provider_id, abi, category, contract_type, recipient_id

partition_key = "recipient_id"
tmp_path = f"{container_path}/tmp/AgentQuarterReport"

df_trx_quarter_recipient\
    .coalesce(1) \
    .write\
    .mode("overwrite")\
    .partitionBy(partition_key)\
    .option("header", "true")\
    .csv(tmp_path)
# Eliminazione File temporanei

tmp_path = f"{container_path}/tmp"

mssparkutils.fs.rm(tmp_path, True)
